data.one_liner: Mock Image.network in widget tests without real network calls
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to test widgets containing Image.network by mocking the internal HTTP client. It prevents HTTP 400 errors during widget tests and avoids real network requests.
use_when: You are writing widget tests for Flutter components that load images via Image.network
You want to prevent network requests during test execution
avoid_when: You are writing non-Flutter Dart tests that do not involve widget rendering
You need real network connectivity in integration tests
strengths: Easy to use with the mockNetworkImages wrapper
Prevents failing network image tests in Flutter
Supports customizable image bytes and image resolvers
weaknesses: Limited to mocking network images in tests

alternatives.name: mockito
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative general mocking framework that can be used for custom mock implementations.
